Label: CMS: Notify Content Author
Description: Notifies the content author that their content variant has been approved, and allows the content author to conditionally view the final feedback for the content variant.

Label: CMS: Review Content
Description: Allows a content manager to conditionally view a content author's feedback, provide revision comments, and approve or request revisions of a content variant.

Label: CMS: Submit Content for Review
Description: Allows a content author to conditionally view a reviewer's feedback, provide revision comments, and submit a content variant for review.

Label: CMS: Withdraw Review Request
Description: Allows a content author to withdraw a review request in order to make changes to the underlying content variant.

Label: Discount Flow
Description: Order Management: Apply discounts to order items.

Label: Even Exchange Flow
Description: Order Management: Even Exchange order products before fulfillment.

Label: Cancel All Eligible Items Flow
Description: Order Management: Cancel all eligible order items before fulfillment.

Label: Cancel Item Flow
Description: Order Management: Cancel order items before fulfillment.

Label: Return Item Flow
Description: Order Management: Return order items after fulfillment.

Label: RMA Return Items
Description: Order Management: Return order items RMA after fulfillment.

Label: Reship Order Flow
Description: Order Management: Reship order items after fulfillment.

Label: Change Case Owner to Incident Owner
Description: When Cases are identified as part of an Incident, change the Case owner to the Incident owner.

Label: Close Change Request & Related Issues
Description: Closes a Change Request and attempts to close its related Incidents, Problems, and Cases.

Label: Create Work Order from Case
Description: Copies case details, like customer and asset information, to create a work order from a case.

Label: Create Draft Flow Approval Process
Description: Creates a draft flow approval process using information provided by the flow user.

Label: Approvals Workflow: Evaluate Approval Requests
Description: Evaluate advanced approval requests to approve or deny them while optionally leaving comments.

Label: Approvals Workflow: Process Approval Submission
Description: Allows a user to process a submission for Standard Approvals or Advanced Approvals. For an approval submission, allows a user to recall or cancel. For an approval work item, allows a user to reassign, review as the assignee, or override the assignee and review as an approval admin.

Label: Review Approval Request
Description: Displays information about a record to be approved and allows the reviewer to approve or reject it. The approver can optionally add comments about their decision.

Label: Review Flow for Activation
Description: Directs the flow user to review the submitted flow in Flow Builder, displays additional information about the submitted flow, and lets the reviewer approve or reject. The reviewer can optionally add comments about their decision.
